verdict.rationale: The docs say `tofu plan -out=FILE` saves a plan to disk, which `tofu apply` can later execute when passed the file. That is the saved-plan-artifact core of the story, and plan files can also be encrypted at rest, which helps with storing CI artifacts. The pack never documents approval flags (e.g. auto-approve) or explicit non-interactive/CI behavior. missing for 10: documented approval/auto-approve flag, explicit non-interactive CI mode documentation, hands-on corroboration of CI pipelines using saved plans
